NEHA BHATIA
QA Tester · Nagpur, India
neha.bhatia.qa@example.com · +91 90000 90123 · linkedin.com/in/neha-bhatia-qa

SUMMARY
Manual QA tester with 1.8 years of experience testing web and mobile apps for a school-fee payments product.

EXPERIENCE

Paywise Systems — QA Tester                                                          Nagpur · Dec 2024 – Present
School-fee payments product (web and Android).
- Wrote and ran 240 manual test cases across the web and Android apps for each fortnightly release.
- Logged 310 bugs in Jira in a year; 92% were fixed by the developers without follow-up questions.
- Started learning Selenium and wrote 6 basic automated checks for the login flow.

EDUCATION
B.Sc. Computer Science — Vidarbha Science College, Nagpur                                            2021 – 2024

SKILLS
Testing: test case design, bug reporting, regression testing, Jira
Automation: Selenium (basic)
